## About
Miami AutoWorks is a body shop and repair center in Miami. We fix cars after accidents, handle everyday maintenance like oil changes, and help owners who want to customize their ride with window tint and performance upgrades.
Mike and the whole team look after domestic, European, Japanese and German vehicles, from Honda and Nissan to BMW, Mercedes and Porsche. Drop your car off and we can shuttle you home or to the office, or you can wait in our comfortable waiting area.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating across 74 Google reviews. Many of them mention how their car came back looking brand new.

## Services
- Collision and body repairs: Accident damage and bumper repairs, done so the car looks like it never got hit.
- Paint work: Bumper paint jobs, panel repairs and custom paint.
- Oil change and full service maintenance: From a basic oil change to complete full service maintenance.
- Diagnostics and exhaust systems: Tracking down what is wrong with your car, plus exhaust work and body kits.
- Performance upgrades: High-end performance upgrades to give your car a high performance look and feel.
- Window tints and alarm systems: Window tints and alarm systems installed.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all major insurance companies, so call us after an accident and we will help you get started.

Q: Do estimates cost anything?
A: No. Estimates are free, and we also offer towing and shuttle service.

Q: What do I do while my car is being worked on?
A: Drop it off and we will shuttle you back to your home or office, or relax in our waiting area.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Domestic vehicles plus European, Japanese, German and other foreign makes, including Lexus, Honda, BMW, Mercedes, Porsche, Acura, Volvo, Corvette and Nissan.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM. We are closed on weekends.
